primary.what: Full docs dump (Mintlify): concepts + all 84 catalog model pages with complete JSON schemas. Canonical source for this file.
OpenAPI 3.1, info.version 2.0.0 - only 9 operations (soul/standard, status, cancel, 4x kling 2.5, 2x hailuo). Partially stale: its soul/standard schema conflicts with the model page.
Public pricing API (backs open.higgsfield.ai/pricing): 31 model families / 83 modes with per-config list + discounted USD
Per-model docs incl. pricing formulas and output schema; also covers higgsfield-ai/soul/v2/image-to-image and higgsfield/ai-influencer (absent from docs catalog)

secondary.what: TS SDK: v2 client (flat body, hf_webhook query param, Authorization: Key) + legacy v1 client (hf-api-key/hf-secret headers, {params} body, DoP/Speak/Soul v1 types, /v1/motions, /v1/custom-references/list)
SDK repo (not cloned; package tarballs inspected instead)

submit.body: flat JSON matching the endpoint input schema (NOT wrapped in "params")

headers.Idempotency-Key: optional, 1-255 visible ASCII chars, no whitespace; UUID recommended

response.note: Use the returned URLs rather than constructing them.

idempotency.replay: same key + same endpoint/body/webhook returns original request_id with no new charge; replay receipt may still say "queued" - read status_url
idempotency.mismatch: 422 {"detail":"Idempotency-Key was already used with different request parameters"}
idempotency.fieldOrder: object key order ignored; array order, omitted fields, explicit nulls and URLs matter

outputs.image: images[].url (Ads Studio adds images[].index and errors[])

status.polling: start 2s, x1.5 backoff to 10s max, add jitter; retry on 5xx/network; stop on 401/404
status.retention: outputs available >= 7 days; copy to own storage

cancel.condition: only while every job in the request is queued; canceled requests are refunded

step2.headers: every key in upload_headers; NO Higgsfield credentials

upload.step3: pass public_url as image_url / image_urls[] / video_url / audio_url(s). There are no file ids - every model takes URLs.
upload.note: Any directly downloadable public/signed HTTPS URL also works; asset:// refs are rejected (Seedance). Content type at PUT must match step1.

webhook.how: ?hf_webhook=<urlencoded https url> on the submit request
webhook.note: Webhook payload nests outputs under payload (status endpoint does not). Respond 2xx within 10s; 5xx/network retried up to 2h; 4xx = permanent; duplicates possible -> dedupe on (request_id,status). No signature/secret is documented for v2 webhooks (legacy v1 had {url,secret}).

rateLimits.exceeded: 400 {"detail":"Maximum number of concurrent requests (N) has been reached"}

errors.422: validation or idempotency mismatch (detail may be a list)

billing.pricingSemantics: pricing API: original_amount = list price; amount = current (launch-discounted) price; when original_amount is null, amount is list

notFound.note: Searched llms-full.txt, the pricing API (83 modes) and per-model docs. These have NO v2 endpoint:
items: DoP image-to-video presets (only legacy /v1/image2video/dop + GET /v1/motions via SDK, verified:false)
Speak / Lipsync / talking avatar (only legacy /v1/speak/higgsfield via SDK, verified:false)
Seedance 2.5 draft mode / draft params (not in schema; additionalProperties:false would reject them)
Kling element creation (elements[] takes Kling element IDs owned by the account but no create endpoint is documented)
Soul Cinema price (missing from pricing API and per-model doc 404)

endpoints.title: Ads Studio — Generate ads

niche.desc: Optional product category or business niche used to guide ad concepts.

prompt.desc: Required marketing brief describing the product or service, desired message and visual direction. Must contain non-whitespace text.

language.desc: Optional language guidance for ad copy, for example en or ru. This is free text, not a fixed language-code enum.

batch_size.desc: Number of ad concepts and requested output images. Billing is summed across the rendered images.

image_urls.desc: Optional product or visual reference images. Supply up to 10 directly downloadable HTTP(S) URLs. Omit or send [] for text-only generation.

aspect_ratio.desc: Output width-to-height ratio shared by every image in the batch.

target_audience.desc: Optional description of the intended audience, such as interests, needs or use cases.

output.extra: images[].index (zero-based batch slot); errors[] lists failed slots

priceUsd.formula: Per 1M tokens: text input $5, cached text input $1.25, text output $10; image input $8, cached image input $2, image output $30. Quality defaults to high. Final cost uses actual token usage and standard credit rounding. The initial charge is an estimate reconciled on completion.

notes: Submit one request with your brief. Ad concepts are prepared automatically, then rendered as images; no separate preparation or generate call is required.
batch_size selects 1–8 ad concepts. Each concept produces one image, so a fully successful batch returns batch_size images.
Rendering uses GPT Image 2.5 Flare with fixed 2k resolution and high quality. Exact dimensions depend on aspect_ratio. quality, resolution, renderer and fallback model are not public inputs.
All outputs in a batch use the requested aspect_ratio. Omitting it selects 1:1. The value auto is not supported.
Per-model dash llms.txt aspect_ratio enum lacks 3:1 and 1:3 (docs page includes them).

endpoints.title: Cinema Studio 4.0 — Generate

prompt.desc: Text instructions for the generation or edit.

priceUsd.formula: Token-metered pricing. Billable video tokens = ceil((input video seconds + generated video seconds) × output width × output height × 24 fps / 1024). Image and audio references do not count as video input. At 480p or 720p, each 1,000 video tokens cost $0.0214 without video input or $0.01284 with video input (0.6× the standard rate). With video references, both input and generated video durations are billable. Rates shown are before any applicable customer discount.

notes: This is the public Cinema Studio 4.0 workflow. It uses text-to-video when references are absent and reference-to-video when any media array is nonempty.
Omit creative-control fields to let the director choose them automatically; the literal value "auto" is not accepted for these enum fields.
Optional prompt references use one-based tokens such as \<\<\<image_1>>>, \<\<\<video_1>>> and \<\<\<audio_1>>>. Each token must refer to an attached item of the same media type.
This endpoint produces a new video. Editing and extension use the separate Seedance 2.5 endpoints.
Reference media are limited to 30 images, 10 videos and 10 audio files, with at most 50 items total. Video and audio may be normalized to separate 30-second total budgets.

prompt.desc: Text instructions for the generation or edit.

video_url.desc: Public URL of the source video.

priceUsd.formula: Per-second pricing. Each second of input video costs $0.318 at 480p, $0.681 at 720p, $1.632 at 1080p. Input duration is rounded up to the nearest whole second. Rates shown are before any applicable customer discount.

notes: Use higgsfield/genjutsu/motion-transfer/v1.0 for new integrations. The legacy endpoint higgsfiled/genjutsu/motion-transfer/v1.0 remains callable for existing clients but is hidden from model discovery.
The source video must be at least 4 seconds. Videos longer than 30 seconds are trimmed to 30 seconds; output duration follows the prepared source video.
Provide 1–8 image references. The prompt is optional and defaults to an empty string.

endpoints.title: Genjutsu — Restyle

prompt.desc: Optional additional guidance for the final video alongside the preset, source motion, and character references. Describe subject roles or details to retain, for example: “Keep the referenced character’s pink hair consistent across shots.” An empty string uses the visual inputs without additional instructions. This supplements preset_id; it does not create a custom style or set duration, resolution, FPS, or audio behavior. Instructions guide a generative result and do not guarantee exact preservation.

preset_id.desc: Required UUID from items[].id in the [available styles](#available-styles) response. Selects one visual style for the subjects and scene. Send the ID, not the style name, preview URL, or list index. A prompt or character image does not replace this field. Hidden or unavailable presets fail input preparation; no alternative style is selected automatically. Custom/personal presets and multiple simultaneous styles are not supported.

video_url.desc: Source video, 4–30 seconds. Longer videos are trimmed to 30 seconds.

image_urls.desc: Optional character references. Leave empty to restyle the source frame.

resolution.desc: Output resolution tier; strings are case-sensitive. Defaults to 720p. Send a supported string such as "720p", not the number 720 or "HD". This setting selects the video price tier and does not set the aspect ratio, duration, or FPS.

priceUsd.formula: Roughly costs $0.318 per second at 480p, $0.681 per second at 720p, or $1.632 per second at 1080p.

notes: Restyle changes the visual style of a source video while retaining its motion, shot composition, and source audio. Each request produces one video.

Select a current style from GET /models/higgsfield/genjutsu/restyle/v1.0/presets and send its UUID as preset_id. The example UUID below is illustrative of a published preset; fetch the current catalog before submitting.
The source must be at least 4 seconds and no larger than 200 MiB. Videos longer than 30 seconds are trimmed to their first 30 seconds, including audio.
Character references are optional: omit image_urls or send [] to restyle the existing source subjects. Supply up to 5 character images to guide their appearance.
Defaults apply to omitted optional fields. Use [] or an empty string where appropriate; null is not accepted.
Output framing is derived from the source and animation cadence can depend on the selected style. Exact output duration and FPS may differ from the source.

Always include a non-empty top-level prompt, including when using multi_prompt. Keep it within 2,500 characters; longer prompts are truncated.
